definitions.meaning: The name of a bird so called from its note

quotations.old_english: Dyde ic mé tó gomene ganetes hleóþor and huilpan swég

source_text: hú-ilpa, an; m. The name of a bird so called from its note [cf. Ger. uhu owl] ? -- Dyde ic mé tó gomene ganetes hleóþor and huilpan swég, Exon. 81 b; Th. 307, 9; Seef. 21.
